saw_lines: Runners rarely buy a carbon plate shoe from one ad. They check fit and reviews first, then reorder the same model.
So a first-time buyer decides in the opening line, and your ads never name free shipping or the first order discount there.
Your 2 live ads carry no proof number, while your site shows 15% off and free shipping. Collect a review count, then open the next ad with it and WELCOME15.
ads_1: Fit-first ads for HORUS and EQUUS, opening on a review count and WELCOME15
